notes: Cleanest folder of the batch. Nine of ten assets usable, all genuine hardscaping work, no flyers, no memes, no screenshots. Only one duplicate found and it was a near identical second exposure of the same walkway rather than a resized copy, so the larger and sharper file was kept. The phone number 856-899-0240 is read from lettering on their own trailer, which is a physical world source rather than a graphic, making it the strongest kind of second source available here, but note it is a single sighting rather than repeated across several images. Several of these are night shots with landscape lighting, which look good but are darker than the rest, so mix them rather than grouping them.
